column3: The Hebrew title does not explicitly add Psalm. Transgression is presented as uttering an oracle to the wicked man.
The Hebrew has an active flattering verb and infinitives of finding and hating; BSB describes eyes too full of conceit to detect sin.
The Hebrew places loving devotion in the heavens; BSB says it reaches to them.
The Hebrew names mountains of God and a great deep; BSB says highest mountains and deepest sea.
The Hebrew pictures being saturated with the fat of Your house; BSB says feasting on abundance.
The Hebrew says they could not rise, using a completed verb; BSB describes being unable to rise.
